name: siteasy
tagline_zh:
从零到上线，前端全流程一站搞定。
改稿、评审、动效、排版，连空状态都帮你打磨，像有个懂设计的工程师随叫随到。
tagline_en: From blank to launch, one skill for all frontend work. Polish, critique, animate, layout—even empty states, like.
desc_en: Use when the user wants to design, build, plan, critique, audit, polish, clarify, simplify, amplify, animate, typeset, layout, adapt, harden, or improve a frontend interface. Covers websites, landing pages, dashboards, product UI, app shells, components, forms, settings, onboarding, and empty states. why_zh: 同类只改界面，它连UX研究、人物画像、信息架构都包了，且能硬核审查Gestalt原则。
why_en: Others tweak UI; this one covers UX research, personas, IA, and Gestalt audits—a rare full-stack design brain in one skill.
